title: Hearty Japanese Rice Onigiri
description: A creamy, umami-packed onigiri made with gelatin-infused rice, wrapped in nori and grilled to a golden finish.
instructions: Prepare the gelatin by sprinkling 1 tsp of unflavored gelatin powder over 2 tbsp of warm water and let it bloom for 2 minutes.
Whisk the bloomed gelatin until it dissolves completely, then stir in 1 tbsp miso paste, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt, and 1 tbsp rice vinegar until smooth.
Gently fold the gelatin‑miso mixture into the 2 cups of freshly cooked, cooled short‑grain Japanese rice, ensuring even distribution.
Divide the seasoned rice into 4 equal portions and shape each into a triangle or oval, forming the onigiri shape.
Cut a 1‑sheet nori into strips and wrap each onigiri by sliding the nori around the rice, pressing gently to seal.
Heat a robata grill over medium heat, and lightly oil the grill grates to prevent sticking.
Place the nori‑wrapped onigiri on the grill, cooking 1–2 minutes per side until the nori is toasted and the rice is warmed.
While grilling, sprinkle 2 tbsp bonito flakes and 1 tbsp sesame seeds over the onigiri for added umami and crunch.
Remove the onigiri from the grill and let them rest for 30 seconds so the flavors meld together.
Serve the creamy, gelatin‑enhanced onigiri hot, accompanied by a side of pickled vegetables if desired.
